items.name: SAP Blue
items.role: the acting colour. Every filled button, every inline text link, and the active product tab.

items.name: Deep Blue
items.role: the solid hero band on interior pages, and the label colour inside an outline button placed on white.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: the label on every blue fill and all type inside the hero band.

items.name: Navy
items.role: the anchor of the home page's hero gradient, the one atmospheric surface in the system.

items.name: Sky
items.role: a light blue panel used inside the services layout.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: the working ground. Content panes, cards and most sections sit on it unchanged.

items.name: Chrome
items.role: the global navigation bar, and the neutral band used to set a section apart.

items.name: Band
items.role: the footer ground, and the largest single non-white surface on the home page.

items.name: Band Blue
items.role: a pale blue strip used to lift a section out of the white run.

items.name: Band Lavender
items.role: a softer wash serving the same role on product pages, with a curved upper edge rather than a square one.

items.name: Ink
items.role: headings at every level. SAP sets its headlines in true black, not a softened near-black.

items.name: Ink Lead
items.role: the 28px lead paragraph that follows a display headline.

items.name: Ink Body
items.role: body copy. A slate rather than a grey, which is what separates the paragraph tier from the lead tier.

items.name: Ink List
items.role: list items, set one step lighter than body.

items.name: Ink Meta
items.role: captions and footnotes, the quietest legible tier.

items.name: Ink Nav
items.role: navigation links, breadcrumbs and tab labels. The only text colour that is a neutral grey rather than a slate, which is how the chrome stays visually separate…

items.name: Hairline
items.role: the rule on an outline button. The same value as , used as a border rather than as type.

strengths.title: 머리 영역을 앱처럼 두 층으로 둔다
strengths.why: 맨 위 60px #f5f6f7 바 아래에 경로와 탭 줄이 한 층 더 붙는다.

strengths.title: 구역은 평평한 띠 네 가지로 나눈다
strengths.why: #f5f6f7, #eaecee(푸터), #ebf8ff, #f7f4ff 띠를 전체 폭, 0px 모서리로 깐다. 그림자나 테두리는 쓰지 않는다.

strengths.title: 파랑 하나만 행동을 맡는다
strengths.why: #0057d2는 버튼, 본문 링크, 활성 탭에만 쓴다. 컨트롤은 8px, 사진은 12px 모서리다.

strengths.title: 같은 크기도 굵기로 구분한다
strengths.why: 72 Brand Variable의 350~700 굵기를 쓴다. 목록 글자는 350, 내비 링크는 400으로 같은 15px라도 다르게 읽힌다.

strengths.title: 글자색이 단계마다 색조를 바꾼다
strengths.why: 제목 #000000에서 #3c3c3c, #223548, #354a5f, #475e75로 내려가며 회색에서 푸른 회색으로 바뀐다.

learn: 섹션을 나눌 때 SAP처럼 선이나 그림자 대신 전체 폭 바탕 띠를 쓰고, 띠 사이에는 흰 구간을 꼭 넣는다.
글자 크기를 바꾸기 어려울 때 SAP처럼 350·400·500 굵기 차이로 같은 15px 글자의 역할을 나눈다.
